methodology: Whole-session known-policy attacks. First half sessions profile; second half are held out. Selected models use per-epoch public features. For os_csprng, known-seed replay was skipped because the public experiment seed does not determine the OS-CSPRNG noise stream. Labels are used for profile training and target scoring only.
limitations: The OS-CSPRNG transcript cannot be replayed from the public seed. Its sampler has a conditional approximate-DP bound under independent uniform bits, but this analysis is not an independent implementation audit. The attack tests only the declared public features; failure to classify does not establish privacy. The naive arm is the leaky positive control. The experiment excludes latency, sampler timing/CPU, errors, billing, network and runtime observations.
